lastCompletedStory.title: Wire model resolution into the review.ts reviewer dispatch

nextStoryContext: src/supervisor/review.ts's makeReviewDispatch (the reviewer dispatch closure) now calls resolvePhaseModel({ phase: 'reviewer', backend: reviewBackend, configPath, cacheReader: codexModelsCacheReaderFn }) in place of the raw readPhaseModel('reviewer', configPath, reviewBackend) read, immediately where that read used to sit -- BEFORE the shellCmd = selectAdapter(reviewBackend).buildSpawnArgv(...) build, and with no reorder of the pre-existing codexAuthPreflight block (still runs right before the respawn-pane call, unchanged position). A not-ok resolution returns the SAME ReviewDispatchResult { status: 'error', detail } shape the codexAuthPreflight not-proceed path already returns (detail prefixed 'model-resolution-failed:' vs that path's 'codex-auth-failed:'), firing opts.escalateFn fire-and-forget first, with zero tmux respawn-pane invocation recorded. A new MakeReviewDispatchOptions.codexModelsCacheReaderFn?: CodexModelsCacheReader field (mirrors codexAuthCheckFn) is the injectable seam; when absent, resolvePhaseModel's own default parameter (readCodexModelsCache) is used, and it is never invoked on a claude-backed dispatch. The PRE-EXISTING CAM-405 configPath seam on MakeReviewDispatchOptions was threaded straight into resolvePhaseModel's own configPath field (no chdir needed anywhere in the new test/supervisor/review-model-resolution.test.ts file: a tmp project.toml path is passed directly through MakeReviewDispatchOptions.configPath per test case, mirroring review.test.ts's own GENERIC_REVIEW_CONFIG_PATH pattern rather than plan-runner-model-resolution.test.ts's chdir dance -- .claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md, needed by CodexAdapter.buildSpawnArgv for a codex-backed dispatch, is read cwd-relative and unaffected by configPath, and is already committed at the repo root). This closes out the CAM-398 model-resolution wiring epic across all 3 supervisor dispatch call sites the US-004 handoff flagged as out-of-scope (loop.ts implementer [US-004], plan-runner.ts planner+auditor [US-005], review.ts reviewer [this story]) -- no remaining call sites are known to be out of scope for this epic; a future story reviving this thread would need a fresh audit of any NEW dispatch site added since. src/supervisor/review.ts crossed its file-size ceiling (689->736, content.split('\n').length); raised in scripts/file-size-budget.json with a tracker-ref-carrying _ref entry, staged before the check:all re-run per the ratchet-gate rubric.

officialDocsValidated.summary: This story wires the already-built (US-003) resolvePhaseModel decision fn into the review.ts reviewer dispatch call site; no new external library or documented API surface was introduced beyond what US-001/US-002/US-003/US-004/US-005 already Step-5.5-validated (Claude Code model-config docs, openai/codex protocol source, ~/.codex/models_cache.json schema).
